questions.answer: You need to be active in class to succeed.

questions.answer: Business associations, business fundamentals, bankruptcy and legal ethics for corporations.

questions.answer: I will recommend business associations, business fundamentals as they both have relations to european law.

questions.answer: Travel around California. The train to San Francisco takes about 1-2 hours.

questions.answer: easy

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Davis has a lot of different international students, so you will always find someone with the same culture.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: People at Davis are very open.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Take advantage of the short time you are there, sign up for clubs and be active in class.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: The facebook-groups UC Davis has is very helpful.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: The people I got to know.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: 4 exams in two weeks.
